other_conditions: Gaushala must have ownership or leased land approved by a competent authority, with lease term of at least 20 years.
Gaushala must have consistently maintained at least 100 cattle for the past two years.
Gaushala must have no pending cases of financial irregularity or embezzlement.
Gaushala must be registered under the Rajasthan Gaushala Act, 1960, the Rajasthan Society Registration Act, 1958, or Lalsamay Pravat Law.
Institutions recommended or approved by the District-Level Gaushala Committee in exceptional circumstances are eligible.
Basic infrastructure should not have been previously constructed; if existing infrastructure is insufficient relative to cattle numbers, additional construction may be granted.
Gaushala should be committed to developing its own resources for self‑reliance and cooperate by sharing information on relevant initiatives.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹10 lakh financial assistance for infrastructure development.
